{{Top|leg}}
'''Atmospheric scrubbers''' were filters used in [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems. The [[Roamer-6 breath mask/Legends|Roamer-6 breath mask]] had six layers of atmospheric scrubbers built into the air purifier that could filter our a number of hazards, including dangerous [[Gas/Legends|gases]], dust particles, pollen, and microscopic contaminants.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
